evals.prompt: Review this landing page: it uses the same hero, three cards, and gradient button as every other AI site. What do you do?
assertions: The output identifies the generic AI-slop pattern rather than praising the layout
The output proposes a distinctive direction, not another gradient button
The output checks mobile, tablet, and desktop views

evals.prompt: The settings form is functional but bland. Make it delightful without breaking the design tokens.
assertions: The output keeps the src/app/globals.css theme tokens as the source of truth
The output does not hardcode hex values in components
The output preserves 44px touch targets and responsive behavior
